postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU El Salvador addressing sheet records four numeric digits: region, department, locality or delivery area, and distribution. Valid syntax or a locality label alone is not proof of a current Correos de El Salvador assignment, reusable boundary, exact address, parcel, building, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A full code can name a locality or delivery area but is not guaranteed to be a polygon. No current authority-published versioned reusable national postal-polygon release was identified. A CNR department, municipality, district or canton boundary, census area, cadastral parcel, postal-office catchment, road network, OSM object, Voronoi cell, buffer, interpolation, API cache or model surface cannot be presented as official postal geometry without authority provenance and explicit reuse rights.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, street or passage, house or building number, block or poligono, lot, floor, unit, P.O. Box, post office, condominium or development, colonia or barrio, caserio, canton, district, municipality, department, locality and four-digit postcode as separate fields. Formatting guidance and synthetic fixtures contain no real example address, person, property or upstream response.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as postal_area, route, po_box, organization, delivery_point, unique_postcode, other_special or unknown. A four-digit value is routing/locality/delivery-area evidence and must not be forced into polygon geometry without assignment-specific source evidence.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a permitted building identifier and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. A postcode, locality, canton, census location, parcel, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: CNR cadastral location products can contain parcel graphics and address or registration context and are paid or purpose-bound services. Parcels remain separate from postal objects, civic addresses and buildings. Owner, possessor, neighbor, registration, value and property identifiers are not public address-display fields and require explicit authority and privacy review.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted Correos, CNR or other calls, mathematical models and machine learning may normalize input, compare observations, compress reviewed geometry, detect drift and produce review candidates. Every output preserves source and service version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and official-observation or derived status. It never overwrites source evidence, invents official geometry or infers a house number, unit, building or occupant.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound postal observations, rights-cleared postal geometry, typed postal objects, administrative context and explicit civic-address-to-building relations to AGID cells without relabelling any source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official El Salvador postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Correos website and UPU sheet provide operational and dated format evidence but no blanket bulk assignment or polygon redistribution grant. CNR geographic-code downloads, cadastral products, ONEC statistical catalogs and every selected artifact require exact terms, version and digest review; paid and personal fields stay excluded. ODbL material remains partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO SV scope. It does not silently extend a source into maritime space, border assertions or uncovered territory. Postal, administrative, census, cadastral and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and boundary vintage remain independent.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact addresses, house or building numbers, coordinates, entrances, floors, units, recipients, residents, owners, possessors, neighbors, cadastral keys, registration records, API responses, credentials and query logs can expose personal, property or security context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal assignments, the 2019 UPU sheet, the current Correos site, CNR geographic-code vintages, the post-2023 department-municipality-district structure, statistical catalogs, parcels, building geometries, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version, service version, digest and supersession independently; never rewrite historical evidence or equate legacy municipalities with current districts without a versioned crosswalk.
